trigger.observed_failure: A fixed-offset keyframe had no visible projection of the unmodified ORION route in any of the six cameras.

keyframe_geometry_eligibility.exclusion_rule: Exclude a candidate keyframe only when the unmodified ORION route has zero visible support across all six camera projections.

claim_boundary: This is a technical camera-projection eligibility rule for fixed candidate frames, not outcome-based sample selection and not evidence that Stage1 UQ or Stage2-L is correct.
